propositions: Manual attempt scheduling in _pai_structured must be replaced with one bounded Agent operation composing the S1 output-policy adapter while preserving full input, response history, and request budget.

A failed ModelResponse reaches the retry wire only when its full token cost (input_tokens + output_tokens + effective_max_tokens) provably fits the model's context window; otherwise it is omitted whole from the wire while retained in all_messages().
Authoritative-input overflow (when input alone exceeds window) must raise ContextWindowExceededError without shortening content.
The shared output-retry counter and request budget must be computed once from base allowance plus output-retry allowance (OUTPUT_RETRIES), with no per-attempt reset.

Truncation-signal guard (length/max_tokens finish_reason) applies concision ModelRetry only to the prompted TextOutput branch; NativeOutput branch preserves terminal truncation via pai_output.guard_capability().
Refusal and content-filter remain terminal after one model call, never triggering output retry or fallback.
